dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa, this place is full of books! And... they're all so full of words. Where are the ones with pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This one's nothing but words, so's this... don't they have, like, an art book or something?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aha, here we go! And it's... a book on Liyue mythology? Yeah, no, not happening. I probably wouldn't understand it anyway...
